text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
La laa laa! ♪ Guess I'd better start
getting ready
for training!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Ah, w-wait! I'm only worried about you!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I ended up losing my cool again... But I just...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Seems like you're having some trouble. If
you
don't mind, I'd like to hear about it.
I might be
able to help. ☆

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I've been getting annoyed at
my weak performance. I know she's
concerned about me,
but she's also my
rival, so it's pretty frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see! So... I know this might seem
unrelated, but what color are your dorm
room bed and pajamas?
They wouldn't
happen to be red, would they?

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Yeah, they are. How did you know
that?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In feng shui, red is a color which raises
your chances of winning in competitions.
However, it can also exacerbate your
emotional ups and
downs.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why having the color red for your
bed, which is supposed to be a place of
peace, can
lead to overstimulation and
irritation.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What you need are some houseplants!
Plants with round leaves can help soothe
your heart, and
even help improve your
relationships!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But that's just the start. As for your
bedding—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey gets so caught up
helping that she
completely forgets
about training.
